about_the_game:
Bring back the good old days behind bars with this nostalgic set from your inmate past. Whether you miss the cell block hustle or just like the look, the Prisoner Pack is your badge of honor from a life once lived.

With this pack you'll get access to:

  • A hat: The iconic striped beanie, worn and washed from years of lockup;

  • Prisoner clothes: A full pinstripe uniform complete with serial number, patched knees, and memories baked into every crease;

  • Gloves: Work-ready gloves with bold markings, perfect for rolling cigarettes or baking cookies under surveillance;

  • Handcuff earrings: Fashion accessories made from freedom’s greatest enemy, now repurposed with ironic flair.
